newsitem.title: JAPAN: CDMA group stresses 'cooperation' with NTT DoCoMo.
newsitem.headline: CDMA group stresses 'cooperation' with NTT DoCoMo.

text.p: An international group promoting CDMA cellular phone technology said on Monday that it wanted to cooperate with a unit of telecommunications giant NTT to develop a next-generation cellular phone format.

"We are having open discussions with NTT," said Perry LaForge, executive director of the CDMA Development Group (CDG), an international association of wireless operators and makers promoting CDMA (code division multiple access) technology.
"We truly hope to come up with a united approach (in developing the next-generation standard)," he said.
NTT DoCoMo is a unit of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp .

LaForge was speaking at a news conference in Tokyo as a so-called "format war" appeared to be shaping up between the NTT DoCoMo group and a group of four CDG members, including Motorola Inc and Qualcomm Inc.
Both recently announced plans to develop separate next-generation cellular phone standards using CDMA technology.
